title: Employee or Independent Contractor Classification under the Fair Labor Standards Act
summary: The Department of Labor proposes a revised standard for determining whether a worker is an employee or an independent contractor under the FLSA, affecting how businesses classify and pay 1099 contractors. Any business engaging independent contractors should reassess its arrangements.
full_text: The Department of Labor proposes to revise its guidance on whether a worker is properly classified as an employee or an independent contractor under the Fair Labor Standards Act. The proposal adopts an economic-reality test weighing multiple factors to determine economic dependence. Businesses that engage independent contractors should review their worker classification and 1099 contractor relationships, because misclassification can create back-pay and overtime liability.
